english.title: Goods vehicle - fail to give own and owners name etc and produce insurance / plating / test certificates - road
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person

(A)_[driving a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence]_
(C)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on a road, namely, **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) on being required by a constable, failed to give your name and address and the name and address of the owner of the vehicle and to produce for examination the relevant certificate of insurance under Part VI of the Road Traffic Act 1988, a plating certificate and a goods vehicle test certificate issued in respect of the vehicle and any trailer drawn by it
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes: Until 1st November 2021, securities or deposits could be used as an alternative to conventional motor insurance. For offences before that date, see H335
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was

(A)_[the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[suspected of being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when an accident occurred owing to its presence]_
(C)_[suspected of committing an offence in relation to the use of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). The defendant failed to give **(..SPECIFY HIS/HER..) name and address and the name and address of the vehicle's owner to a police constable when requested to do so and failed to produce for examination a relevant certificate of insurance, a plating certificate and goods vehicle test certificate in respect of **(..SPECIFY THE VEHICLE/A TRAILER/THE VEHICLE AND A TRAILER DRAWN BY IT..) when requested to do so, either then or within seven days thereafter.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
